title: Canadian Roast Beef Delight
description: A classic roast beef dish infused with a hint of Canadian flavor, perfect for a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: Roast Beef (Canadian Cut)
ingredients.notes: Prime rib or top round works well.

ingredients.name: Fresh Thyme
ingredients.notes: Chopped or whole sprigs work well.

instructions: Season the roast beef with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Rub the minced garlic over the roast beef, making sure to coat evenly.
Place the roast beef in a roasting pan and put it in the oven.
Roast for 15 minutes per pound, or until the internal temperature reaches 135°F (57°C) for medium-rare.
Remove the roast beef from the oven and let it rest for 10-15 minutes.
Slice the roast beef against the grain and serve.
